memo_security.value:
IJAARO DB (Supabase/PostgreSQL + RLS)

Stack: React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Supabase

Security:
• tenant_id on scoped tables
• RLS default-deny
• Rent approve = landlord only
• Utility approve = same company tenant
• responsible_party_id is immutable snapshot
• No duplicate properties on utility link

memo_chain.value:
Canonical chain:
Property → Assignment → Rent Charge → Rent Payment
Property → Utility Account → Meter → Reading → Bill → Utility Payment
